label: Mainly oxygenation failure (shunt / refractory hypoxaemia)
description: Severe V/Q mismatch or intrapulmonary shunt requiring PEEP/FiO2 optimisation

label: Mainly ventilation failure (hypoventilation / severe acidaemia)
description: Inadequate alveolar ventilation relative to CO2 production

label: Raised airway resistance (bronchospasm / airway narrowing)
description: Marked resistive load; high peak pressure with normal or lower plateau

label: Reduced respiratory compliance (stiff lung / chest wall)
description: Low lung compliance requiring lung protection; elevated plateau pressure

label: Dynamic hyperinflation & auto-PEEP (air trapping)
description: Incomplete exhalation leading to intrinsic PEEP and hemodynamic compromise

label: Patient-ventilator dyssynchrony (missed trigger / fighting)
description: Mismatch between patient neural respiratory effort and ventilator delivery

label: Cardiogenic pulmonary oedema (elevated filling pressures)
description: Acute hydrostatic alveolar flooding responsive to positive airway pressure and afterload reduction

label: Equipment, circuit, or tube problem (DOPE / pneumothorax)
description: Acute tension pneumothorax, mechanical obstruction, tube displacement, or circuit problem

label: Weaning intolerance / SBT failure (excessive load)
description: Rapid shallow breathing, fatigue, or distress during low-support trial requiring increased ventilatory assist

label: Weaning tolerance / liberation ready
description: Quiet, stable spontaneous breathing with adequate mechanics and gas exchange supporting liberation assessment

label: Not sure yet (gathering clinical data)
description: Working hypothesis pending further diagnostic maneuvers and physiological response
